b3/firmware/Makefile.note: the host twins' build (twin, record-twin, wire-twin, wire-parity, orch-twin) into the top-level ignored build/; not the image build.

b3/firmware/b2_search.c.note: B2's engine and its two operators, unchanged (E1): the R and F arms run it through b2_search_init; the O arm through b3_online_init (b3_online_view.c), never b2_search_init.

b3/firmware/b3_app.c.note: DERIVED from B2's application: the orchestrator is b3_orch.c (three arms, the O arm's observation inside it), b3_orch_observe < 0 and a search block that does not render are PROTOCOL (no record without its block), app_identity 1.6.0 (carto_version, arms, b1_map_cost) with the slice decoded by b3_page_slice and a page that is neither the B3 nor the B3Q profile an identity finding, and every outbound buffer sized from the theoretical maximum of its encoder (B3_*_MAX, held by b3/tests/test_b3_app_audit.py) with the base64 step checked against its buffer before it runs. The HAL, the transactions, the audit pull, the watchdog, the closing control and the AXI allowlist are B2's. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_carto.c.note: the specimen cartographer, the C twin of b3/host/b3_carto.py (image stage 1).

b3/firmware/b3_carto_twin.c.note: the cartographer's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_carto_twin.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_online_view.c.note: the O arm's initializer and online view (image stage 2).

b3/firmware/b3_orch.c.note: DERIVED from B2's orchestrator: three arms per pair in the prefix-balanced order (RFO, FOR, ORF, ROF, OFR, FRO by r mod 6), the three searches then the three holdouts; R / F through b2_search_init, O through b3_online_init with a fresh cartographer per pair; the O arm's board observation (the served parent / child delta before the search observes, the cartographer, the view rebuilt on a decode, the ledger entry held until the block renders; the holdout and an unscored candidate update no map); blocks from b2_search_record_json (R, F) and b3_record_json (O); the outer arm B3_WIRE_ARM_*; the formal B3 seed rule (b3_pair_seeds over b3_seed_data.h, B3Q excluding B3's pairs) and the exact (master, budget, pairs_total) profile check at init. B2's page-flags slice layout is kept. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_orch.h.note: DERIVED from B2's orchestrator header: the B3 state (three searches, the cartographer, its scratch, the ledger arrays — all caller-owned), the phases of three arms, the seed and profile API, b3_orch_observe returning a status. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_orch_twin.c.note: the orchestrator's host driver, linked with --wrap on b2_search_init and b3_online_init (b3/tests/test_b3_orch_twin.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_record.c.note: the O arm's combined commitment, ledger entry and record block (image stage 2).

b3/firmware/b3_record_twin.c.note: the O arm's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_record_twin.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_seed_data.h.note: GENERATED: the formal B3 seed rule's sorted excluded set (b3_plan.session_exclusion() plus b2_search.EXCLUDED_SEEDS), the B3 and B3Q profiles and the source binding; nothing of the prediction (b3/tests/test_b3_orch_twin.py holds it to a fresh render).

b3/firmware/b3_wire.c.note: DERIVED from B2's wire unit: app_identity 1.6.0 (carto_version, arms, b1_map_cost in their sorted positions), loop_record 1.4.0 (the pre-rendered search block — B2's renderer's on R / F, b3_record_json's on O — embedded as given), and the outer arm refused unless it is random_safe | map_guided | online. Everything else is B2's byte for byte (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py, the B2 parity). It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_wire.h.note: DERIVED from B2's wire header: the identity's three B3 fields, the B3_WIRE_ARM_* names, B3_WIRE_ARMS and B3_WIRE_B1_MAP_COST, the 1.4.0 comments and the include guard. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_wire_parity.c.note: the B2 / B3 wire parity driver, compiled against both wire units (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_wire_twin.c.note: the wire's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/bsp/build.sh.note: DERIVED from B2's build script: the B3 application's translation units, the image name b3_app, the intermediate products in the top-level ignored build/b3_bsp/ and only the image (b3_app.bin / b3_app.elf) in b3/firmware/bsp/out/, -fstack-usage -fcallgraph-info=su added to the compile flags, the repository root taken from the script's location. The architecture, the BSP, the toolchain and every link setting are B2's. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/bsp/include/bspconfig.h.note: the BSP configuration header, as B2 carries it.

b3/firmware/bsp/include/xmem_config.h.note: the BSP memory configuration header, as B2 carries it.

b3/firmware/bsp/include/xparameters.h.note: the BSP parameters header, as B2 carries it.

b3/firmware/bsp/lscript.ld.note: the BSP linker script, as B2 carries it (the 0x4000 main stack and the mode stacks the stack assessment reads).

b3/firmware/bsp/out/b3_app.bin.note: the committed image (the owner's ruling of 2026-09-28): built by bsp/build.sh from the sources above, reproduced byte for byte by two clean builds recorded in the build evidence.

b3/firmware/bsp/out/b3_app.elf.note: the committed image (the owner's ruling of 2026-09-28): built by bsp/build.sh from the sources above, reproduced byte for byte by two clean builds recorded in the build evidence.

b3/firmware/bsp/src/console.c.note: the BSP console glue (outbyte / inbyte / RX FIFO), as B2 carries it.

b3/firmware/p3_data.h.note: B2's generated data header (host/gen_b2_data.py): the B1 self-map compiled as B2 compiled it — B2_MAP_INIT for the F arm's column view only, B2_MAP_LUT / B2_MAP_INIT for the universe mask — the train / holdout vectors, the seed exclusion.

b3/firmware/p3_derive.c.note: the instrument's derive unit (sha256, CRC-32, the genome codec), as B2 imported it from the instrument (firmware/b2/IMPORT.json, kind=verbatim).

b3/firmware/p3_derive.h.note: the instrument's derive header, as B2 imported it.

b3/firmware/p3_pull.c.note: the instrument's audit-pull unit, as B2 imported it.

b3/firmware/p3_pull.h.note: the instrument's audit-pull header, as B2 imported it.

b3/firmware/p3_rectx.c.note: the instrument's REC transaction unit (rec-v3 / rel-v4), as B2 imported it (firmware/b2/IMPORT.json, kind=verbatim).

b3/firmware/p3_rectx.h.note: the instrument's REC transaction header, as B2 imported it.

scope: the final image import inventory of b3/firmware at image stage 5 — every file under it but this table, each classified verbatim (a byte-for-byte copy of a B2 file), derived (a B2 file changed as its note says, base and derived digests recorded), new (B3's own, no base) or built (the committed image, produced by bsp/build.sh and bound to the build evidence). The host application (image stage 6) lives outside b3/firmware. The pin table has not been generated.
